caption: The drawing depicts a single object centrally placed within a rectangular frame on a plain background. The object consists of a round, dark brown tray with a scalloped, fluted edge. Rising vertically from the tray's back edge is an ornate bracket or support with intricate scrollwork designs, also rendered in a similar dark brown hue. The bracket has two upward-pointing, curved terminal points at the top, resembling stylized animal forms, and is anchored to the tray by two rectangular supports. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a small line sketch showing the object in a simplified plan view, with basic dimensions noted next to it. The drawing utilizes shades of brown and muted gray to illustrate the shadows and contours of the object, demonstrating its three-dimensional form.
title: Foot Scraper
